bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
w="$r/.worktrees/room-userbot-readback-63f062f"
b="$HOME/.local/state/gace-userbot-public-readback-rollback-20261113"
u=gace-userbot-verify.service
sha=63f062fc755e625d366fb3ac3e1541878498ea5c
test "$(git -C "$w" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$sha" || exit 70
test ! -e "$b" || exit 71
test "$(systemctl --user is-active "$u")" = active || exit 72
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled "$u")" = enabled || exit 73
test "$(stat -c %a "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session")" = 600 || exit 74
for n in userbot_resident_ipc.py userbot_test_client.py; do test -f "$w/scripts/$n" && test -f "$r/scripts/$n" || exit 75; done
mkdir -m 700 -p "$b"
for n in userbot_resident_ipc.py userbot_test_client.py; do cp -p "$r/scripts/$n" "$b/$n"; done
rollback() {
 echo USERBOT_CODE_ROLLBACK
 for n in userbot_resident_ipc.py userbot_test_client.py; do cp -p "$b/$n" "$r/scripts/$n"; done
 systemctl --user restart "$u" || :
}
trap rollback ERR
for n in userbot_resident_ipc.py userbot_test_client.py; do install -m 600 "$w/scripts/$n" "$r/scripts/$n.new"; mv -f "$r/scripts/$n.new" "$r/scripts/$n"; done
cd "$r/scripts"
"$r/deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python" -B "$w/scripts/test_userbot_resident_ipc.py" || exit 76
before=$(systemctl --user show "$u" -p MainPID --value)
systemctl --user restart "$u" || exit 77
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
 if test "$(systemctl --user is-active "$u" || :)" = active && test -S "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock"; then
  if "$r/deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python" -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health; then break; fi
 fi
 sleep 1
done
"$r/deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python" -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health || exit 78
test "$(systemctl --user show "$u" -p MainPID --value)" != "$before" || exit 79
test "$(stat -c %a "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session")" = 600 || exit 80
test "$(stat -c %a "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock")" = 600 || exit 81
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled "$u")" = enabled || exit 82
trap - ERR
echo USERBOT_ROOM_PUBLIC_READBACK_RUNTIME_PASS
echo USERBOT_OLD_CODE_SAVED=YES
echo USERBOT_SESSION_REENROLL=NO
echo SOURCE_SHA="$sha"
